meta.description: Turn your idea into a business model with calculated numbers: a structured diagnostic, a report with a clear verdict, and an AI mentor.

footer.disclaimer: A planning tool, not legal or financial advice.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may have changed, or the page may have been removed.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: This page could not be shown. Everything you saved is safe. Try again, or come back in a few minutes.

aboutYou.countryHint: We use it to pick the country data for your analysis. You can change it later.
aboutYou.project: Do you have a project or a project idea?
aboutYou.terms: I accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and have read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
aboutYou.crossborder: I agree that the answers I type are sent to Anthropic in the United States, to check and rewrite them and, later, to run the AI mentor. The name on my Google account and email addresses are removed first, and so are the phone numbers, links, bank account (IBAN) and ID numbers the platform recognises. (Optional)
aboutYou.crossborderHint: Without this consent the whole platform works with its fixed checks, except the AI review and the AI mentor. Names you type yourself, and numbers that could be amounts, are sent as written, so describe people by their role and leave contact details out. You can change your mind at any time on your account page.
aboutYou.termsRequired: An account cannot be created without accepting the terms of use.

aboutYou.closedBody: We will open sign-ups in your country soon.
aboutYou.nothingStored: We have not kept any information about you.

onboarding.title: Complete your account

projects.title: My projects
projects.empty: No projects yet. Start your first one, then answer the diagnostic questions in order.
projects.limit: The free plan allows one project. To start another, delete the current one from its page, or wait for paid plans to open.
projects.newLead: A working name is enough. The country and currency set the data for the analysis and cannot change once you start.

projects.countryHint: The country you will operate in.

account.title: My account
account.languageHint: The language of the interface and of our emails.
account.crossborderTitle: AI review and processing outside your country
account.crossborderScope: With this consent, the answers you type are sent to Anthropic in the United States, to check and rewrite them and, later, to run the AI mentor. Removed first: the name on your Google account; email addresses; phone numbers that start with an international prefix or a 0, and numbers in international form after a word such as “phone” or “WhatsApp”; links to a page, such as a profile or a chat; bank account numbers in IBAN form; and ID numbers after a word such as “national number” or “passport”. Other numbers, and names you type yourself, are sent as written.
account.crossborderOff: Your consent is off: the AI review and the AI mentor are off, and the rest of the platform works fully with its fixed checks.
account.crossborderOutdated: The consent text has changed since you agreed to it. Until you renew your consent for the text above, your typed answers get the fixed checks only.
account.deleteBody: Deletes your account and everything linked to it, at once and for good.
account.deleteConfirmBody: Your account and all your data will be deleted at once and cannot be recovered.

goodbye.title: Your account has been deleted
goodbye.body: We deleted your account and everything linked to it. You are welcome back at any time.
